tutorial.trickDisplay: The trick area shows the cards each of the three players plays.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Select a card to play.

trumpFixed: Trump is the four jacks (♣J > ♠J > ♥J > ♦J). There is no bidding.
scoringNote: Whoever takes the most card points loses that many — the goal is to take nothing.
skatLabel: Skat (goes to whoever wins the last trick)

hint.avoid_points: duck with a card worth nothing and take no points
hint.lead_low: lead something cheap so you do not put points on the table
hint.forced_discard: only point cards are legal here, so give up the cheapest
